We tried doing everything on the Disney Adventure!
Our journey started in Singapore, where we boarded the Disney Adventure for a 3D/2N cruise packed with incredible experiences, endless entertainment, delicious food and a whole lot of Disney magic.
In this video, I'm taking you along on our entire Disney Adventure experience and sharing 30 things you can experience on board. If you're planning a cruise holiday with your family or are simply curious about what life on a Disney cruise looks like, this one's for you!
